caption: Do racing wheels come with pedals? These three starter wheels ship with them: the Logitech G923 for PlayStation ($230), the Thrustmaster T248R ($300) and the Moza R3 for Xbox ($329). Day one, the base clamps to a desk and the pedals sit on the floor. Prices are our estimates. We earn from qualifying purchases. #simracing #ps5
title: Do racing wheels come with pedals? Open one starter box
